request: Swap subscribe's arguments so the selector comes before the listener, letting the callback infer its input without an explicit generic; that would remove repeated type annotations in our subscriptions.

source.request: Swap subscribe's arguments so the selector comes before the listener, letting the callback infer its input without an explicit generic; that would remove repeated type annotations in our subscriptions.
source.settled: Maintainers declined swapping subscription arguments solely to solve the TypeScript inference limitation.
source.why: This makes the API change that maintainers explicitly refused to make just for types.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
